decisions.statement: An unsubscribe once fired is not taken back.
An unsubscribe goes by the message's own List-Unsubscribe headers.
One-click is used only where the sender says one-click is offered.
A mailto is fallen back to where one-click is not offered.
An unsubscribe that threw after Gmail took the mailto says the mailto went.
An unsubscribe refused over a one-click answer says the POST reached the server.
Nothing here follows a link found in a message body.
Nothing here says the effect an unsubscribe would have without doing that unsubscribe.

definition: the command getting off the list one message came from, by the headers it has
